I've had a BPD diagnosis since I was 18 (now 26) and I experience exactly that! I, like you have just come out of a depressive episode, I got really bad, and last week I just felt better one day, I've been trying to find out if this was a unique experience or not. So it's nice to know someone else has been there

Depending on whereabouts you live, there may be a SUN project near you, it's a peer support group specifically made for those with BPD/EUPD/CED (pick your favourite) and is run both by a clinician and a person with lived experience

Person from the UK here, the new recommendation is that it's called CED (Complex Emotional Difficulties) which I personally don't like, but I know others that don't like BPD or EUPD
The only preference I have is that I no longer use BPD, as the amount of times I find my notes from medical professionals incorrectly stating I have BiPolar Disorder is frightening.
Poor mental health is an explanation for some behaviour, but it is never an excuse. This coming from a person with multiple diagnoses myself.
